title: Transactional Outbox Implementation
description: Implement the transactional outbox with code examples.

data.text: Let us implement the transactional outbox pattern with code. We will use a database outbox table and a relay process.

terms.definition: A record in the outbox table representing an event.
A background process that publishes outbox events.
A publisher that can safely retry publishing.
Using Change Data Capture to detect outbox changes.

data.text: The outbox table stores events with their payload, type, and publication status.
